## Usage basis

Herbenzo Ayurvedic and Herbal Pvt Ltd is an MSME-registered entity. The IMPPAT
team confirmed by email on 6 October 2026 that an MSME entity can use IMPPAT
without any formal approval. That confirmation is the owner's record; keep the
email on file. IMPPAT may be used directly in this pipeline.

The email covers use. It does not cover redistribution. IMPPAT batch files are
fetched into the gitignored local cache (`data/external/imppat/cache/`) and are
not committed to this repository.
